headline: CausalWAM adds sparse action-relevance routing to a world-action model
summary: The CausalWAM preprint presents an identifiability result for action-relevant latent factors under support-sparsity assumptions and reports adding a sparse router to a world-action model. In author-run evaluations, the paper reports gains over its baseline on 13 of 17 RoboCasa365 tasks (macro success 0.24 to 0.43), higher results across 40 LIBERO tasks, and a majority of successes over the baseline in 50 Franka cube-stack trials per policy. These are single-preprint results, not independent replications. The implementation retains a dense visual-to-action path; the paper's routed-only intervention covers four selected high-success tasks and does not establish that the learned theoretical support alone drives actions generally.
